15.  Pains  in  the  head,  recurring  on  the  third  and  fourth  day.
Pain  in  the  left  ear,  on  the  first  day.  Stool  easier.  Heat
in  the  eyes.  Sore  eyes.  20.  Drowsy  day  and  night.
Constant  restlessness  during  sleep.  Exaltation  of  ideas.
Loathing  of  food,  loss  of  appetite.  Pain  at  the  left  shoulder,
hindering  breathing  when  walking.  25.  Pustules  on  the
penis.  Eruption  on  the  legs.  Toothache  for  four  days.
Pimples  on  the  occiput,  on  the  fourteenth  day.  Vomiting,  on
the  sixteenth  day.  30.  Urging  to  stool,  with  soft  faeces.
